title: Law to create a Department of Community Safety
summary: This bill would establish a new city Department of Community Safety, led by a mayoral-appointed commissioner, to coordinate emergency responses, social services and crime prevention efforts. The department would operate at least one office in every borough around the clock, run field teams for outreach, safety patrols and conflict mediation, and oversee contracts for alternatives to incarceration and reentry services. The law would take effect 180 days after being enacted.
